answer_2.quote: Experimental results show that our moderation significantly out‑performs other methods in this binary classification setting. Specifically, it achieves 93% accuracy ... and an exact‑match accuracy of 71.3% in multi‑classification settings.

answer_3.quote: We propose an effective model‑based evaluation pipeline using RM and CM by utilizing the decoupled characteristics of helpfulness and harmlessness in PKU‑SAFERLHF.

answer_4.quote: We assemble a team of over 28 annotators for the PKU‑SAFERLHF dataset. Human evaluators rated model outputs on helpfulness and harmlessness according to detailed guidelines.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters evaluated the generated outputs using a set of criteria defined in the annotation guidelines.
